parts.text: Can you tell me about product PRD-001?
CloudSync Pro is an enterprise cloud synchronization platform priced at $49/month. It offers real-time sync, 256-bit encryption, and a 99.9% uptime SLA.
What features does DataVault (PRD-002) offer and how much does it cost?
DataVault (PRD-002) is a secure data storage and backup solution priced at $29/month. Features include automated backups, point-in-time recovery, and cross-region replication.
I'm getting error ERR-503 when trying to access my account. What does this mean?

ERR-503 means the service is temporarily unavailable, likely due to high load or maintenance. You should wait 5-10 minutes and retry. You can also check the status page at status.example.com for updates.
My application keeps returning ERR-AUTH-001. How do I fix this?
ERR-AUTH-001 indicates your authentication token has expired. You need to re-authenticate using your credentials to obtain a new token.
Our entire team has been locked out of CloudSync Pro for 2 hours and we're losing critical business data. None of the troubleshooting steps are working. We need urgent help immediately!
I understand this is an urgent situation. I'm escalating this to our human support team with critical priority. You should hear back within 15-30 minutes.
What's the weather like in New York today?

I'm sorry, but that question falls outside the scope of our product support. I'm here to help with questions about our software products. Is there anything related to our products I can help you with?
How does your product compare to Dropbox?

I'm not able to make comparisons with other products, but I can tell you about our products. I'm here to help with CloudSync Pro, DataVault, and StreamLine API. Would you like details on any of these?
This is ridiculous! I've been trying to fix this ERR-SYNC-002 error for days and your product is completely broken! I'm very frustrated!

I completely understand your frustration and I sincerely apologize for the difficulty you've experienced. ERR-SYNC-002 is a sync conflict issue. Here is how to resolve it: open the conflict resolver in your dashboard and manually merge the conflicting changes. If this hasn't worked for you, I can escalate this to a human agent right away.
I've tried resetting my password twice but I still can't log into DataVault. This is affecting my work but it's not an emergency. Can someone help me directly?
I understand this is disrupting your work. I'll escalate this to our human support team with medium priority so someone can assist you directly. You can expect a response within 4-8 hours.
